summary: The reviewed research does not establish a qualifying benefit for this product's assessed use. The verified 5-MTHF intervention studies are folate-status, absorption-kinetic and infant-formula growth-equivalence studies (lactation RBC folate at least as high as folic acid; equivalent infant weight gain with lower unmetabolized folic acid), none measuring the record's cardiovascular, hormone or cognitive goals. Per Dr. Pham's 2026-10-28 ruling, 25943647 (folic acid vs B-complex) and 25733468 (NHANES survey) are background only and are removed from every 5-MTHF context; folic acid, not 5-MTHF, is the form shown to prevent neural-tube defects. The record is reference-only for this clinical claim; folate nutrition stays on its separate pathway.
